title: Quiz: Asking Good Questions
description: Check your understanding of Asking Good Questions.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in TypeScript?
questions.explanation: In TypeScript, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: Which question is most likely to get a helpful answer?
options: "In Python 3.12, this 5-line script prints None instead of 5 — why?"
questions.correctAnswer: "In Python 3.12, this 5-line script prints None instead of 5 — why?"
questions.explanation: Specific context lets others reproduce and diagnose quickly.

questions.question: True or False: Simplifying failing code to the smallest example helps debugging AND helps others help you.
Fill in the blank: include expected vs ___ output in your question
questions.explanation: Comparing expected and actual reveals the gap precisely.

questions.question: In TypeScript, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
